memory_candidates.content: In the nixos-unstable pin as of mid-2026, nixpkgs' Python Z3 bindings attribute was renamed from `python3Packages.z3` to `python3Packages.z3-solver` (a naming collision with the PyPI wheel of the same name). It is still the nixpkgs-native, source-built derivation (built from Z3Prover/z3 GitHub source, `meta.description` = 'High-performance theorem prover and SMT solver'), NOT the PyPI wheel -- but it ships no PyPI dist-info at all, so buildPythonPackage's pythonRuntimeDepsCheckHook can never be satisfied for a pyproject.toml `z3-solver` dependency by relaxing the version constraint (`pythonRelaxDeps`) alone; the requirement must be stripped entirely via `pythonRemoveDeps = [ "z3-solver" ]` plus `nativeBuildInputs = [ pythonRelaxDepsHook ]`.

For a hermetic `nix flake check` pytest gate that should stay decoupled from the package's own build/doCheck machinery, use a plain `pkgs.stdenv.mkDerivation` with `nativeBuildInputs = [ (python.withPackages (...)) ]`, `dontBuild = true`, and a `checkPhase` that directly invokes `pytest <scoped-path> -n <N> -q`, rather than routing through `buildPythonPackage`'s pytestCheckHook -- this avoids re-running package-build steps just to execute a scoped test subset and keeps the check's pytest scope decision (e.g. excluding a known-flaky or out-of-scope subtree) fully explicit and independently documented.
